evidence_quotes.O: After years of shooting outdoors, I decided it was time to learn about shooting with artificial lighting.
evidence_quotes.C: I performed a side-by-side evaluation of the two cards. Both are 32 GB, but one is supposedly twice as fast as the other.
evidence_quotes.E: I've rarely been so happy to be wrong. It is an excellent camera, especially when you ignore its many automatic modes and use it as a serious photographer.
evidence_quotes.A: When other reviewers discuss the quality of documentation, they are being too kind. It would serve ePhoto well to hire an actual English speaker to write the instruction page.
evidence_quotes.N: After one of my old MyCloud drives bit the dust (it happens) I set up a NAS from another company.
